loss: answer CE plus replay-only exact forward KL for A2/S2; T=lambda=1; shared total-answer-token denominator
endpoint: Fixed update16; all six preregistered endpoints receive one final test. No test-driven checkpoint selection or auto-promotion. Parent default.
test_blinding: Development science reviewed and gates applied before sealed test summaries are opened
precision: FP32 stored weights, vocabulary heads, teacher and evaluation; BF16 autocast student body during training; TF32 disabled
kernels: One pinned torch fallback for all arms; record runtime versions and control results
training_batch: Stable length-sort within each frozen update; right-pad groups of at most8 rows; gather only real answer positions; accumulate to shared >=4096-answer-token denominator
code_guardrail: Historical authored code cases veto losses only; gains do not count as primary improvement
science_guardrail: One item per science family in each split: any individual science loss vetoes promotion
program_extras: All-tests grade includes Claude-approved domain-valid extras; supplied-only grade also reported
limitations: Fresh numeric instances share task families/templates with training/replay; this is not novel-family generalization.
Program source groups are disjoint; single supplied I/O is weaker than authored edge/property checks.
Several held-out programs are simple interfaces, formatting or arithmetic; program gains do not establish reasoning recovery.
Science applications and prompts differ, but taught concepts can overlap.
No claim of absence from source-model pretraining. Known historical groups/prompts are excluded where metadata permits.
Stock arms start fresh; projected arms continue a trained parent. Their interaction is not a clean projection-only causal effect.

Learning rate, curriculum and dose differ from prior studies; only A1/A2 and S1/S2 isolate the added KL term. Horizon I/O-prediction training was removed in favor of independently verified program-writing examples.
evaluation_order: All fixed endpoints dev/test first; CUDA0b stock,A0,A1,A2,S1,S2, with S0 an explicit identical-stock alias; historical veto regressions last. S1/S2 0b may be skipped for deadline, recorded as missing, with no promotion on missing evidence.
runtime_batch_gate: FP32 batched vs independent hybrid Qwen loss/gradients; BF16 gradient relative L2<2%, cosine>.999; same implementation for all four arms
initial_kl_floor: A2/S2 first-update replay rows before any update, BF16 student body and FP32 head versus FP32 teacher
